Reading quest — My first concert · part 1
text: My name is Emily, and I live in **Charlotte**. I love music. I like pop and country, and my friend Simone likes rock. We always say, “**Turn it up**!” when a good song starts. “**Nice tune**!” is our favorite phrase.
Last week Simone asked me, “Who is your favorite singer?” “I love Taylor Swift,” I said. “Me too!” she said. “Do you have tickets?” “Not yet. They are expensive,” I said. “Let’s buy them together.”

Next day we got the tickets online. I felt very happy. I took my old guitar and played the same song again and again. **Practice makes perfect**, my teacher says. “**Play it again**!” Simone said, and I played the song three more times.

fast.why: Emily and Simone talk about music and buy tickets.

Tickets is plural, so use are.
With instruments, use play the + instrument.

pages.title: Writing — your turn
pages.task: Você está numa banda. Diga que instrumento você toca e que instrumento um amigo toca. Ligue à referência Guitar Hero: é o jogo da guitarra de plástico.
pages.model: I play the guitar. My friend plays the piano. Guitar Hero helps here.

items: Say your favorite singer and song.
Write 3 sentences: I like… / I love…
Listen to the dialogue again and shadow Simone.
Review: Turn it up! / Play it again! / Nice tune!
